title: San Diego Gaslamp Quarter Walking Food Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Not recommended for travelers with severe food allergies
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: This tour takes you on a mouthwatering journey through San Diego's diverse food scene, from crispy fish tacos and authentic Baja-style tacos to a classic California burger loaded with fresh, local produce. Finish things off with a scoop of handcrafted ice cream from a beloved neighborhood shop. Each stop reveals the flavors and stories that make San Diego's culinary culture so unique. Please note that food offerings are subject to change based on restaurant availability.
